risks.risk: Gas burners may not ignite or may leak gas.
risks.proof: A video showing all four burners lit and burning steadily.

risks.risk: Oven may not heat or may have a faulty thermostat.
risks.proof: A video showing the oven light on and the interior heating up.

risks.risk: The plastic wrap may conceal scratches, rust, or damage to the exterior.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the front, back, and sides of the cooker without the plastic.

risks.risk: The actual capacity and model may differ from the description.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's specification plate, usually found on the back or side.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of all four gas burners lit and burning.
Video of the oven light on and the oven heating up.
Clear photos of the cooker without the plastic wrapping.
Photo of the manufacturer's specification plate.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
